kind_of_thing.why: Gravel is a loose aggregation of rock fragments that occurs naturally on Earth through geological processes.

kind_of_nature.why: Gravel is loose rock fragments found on the Earth's surface, so it belongs with rocks and soil.

what_happens_when_wet.why: Gravel is loose rock particles, so wetting it does not make it sticky or mushy and it does not wash away like soil.
